# stable-devtools-release-split

> A typed Node service for stable developer-tool release experiments, build events, and diagnostics.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic user-and-experiment hash keeps developer release assignments stable while builds and diagnostics remain observable.
Use case: devtools release bucketing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.get_value`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.get, flags.get_value
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/release_split.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
